content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps: (1) amide formation from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). (2) Doebner modification to form α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid. (3) sulfonamide formation from amine + sulfonyl chloride.

Thus retrosynthetic direction: target -> disconnect amide bond between C(=O)N and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor: acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2)cc1? Wait the amide is attached to aromatic ring c3ccccc3N (an aniline). The amide carbonyl attached to N of aniline (anilide). So retrosynthesis: break amide to give carboxylic acid (α,β-unsaturated) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor 1: α,β-unsaturated acid attached to sulfonyl phenyl: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2)cc1 (i.e., same but COOH instead of CONH-aniline). Precursor 2: aniline (c3ccccc3N). That's step 1.

Step 2: The α,β-unsaturated acid derived from Doebner modification of aromatic aldehyde (para-substituted phenyl with sulfonyl group). The aldehyde would be Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1 (i.e., same but aldehyde instead of unsaturated acid). Reaction: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid (with double bond). So precursor for step2: aromatic aldehyde with sulfonyl phenyl attached.

Step3: The sulfonamide formation: the sulfonyl phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) attached to sulfonyl chloride reacting with aniline (or amine) to give sulfonamide. In our target, the sulfonamide is attached to the first phenyl ring (toluene). Actually structure: toluene ring (methyl phenyl) attached to NS(=O)(=O) attached to second phenyl ring (which bears the unsaturated amide). So sulfonamide formed between aniline (the toluene ring's amine) and sulfonyl chloride derived from second phenyl ring (sulfonyl chloride). So step3: break sulfonamide to give amine (toluene aniline) and sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride). So precursor: toluene aniline (p-methyl aniline) and aryl sulfonyl chloride (p-sulfonyl chloride phenyl with aldehyde). The aldehyde is on that phenyl ring (para to sulfonyl). So we need to propose route: target -> (1) amide disconnection -> unsaturated acid + aniline. (2) unsaturated acid from Doebner: aldehyde + malonic acid. (3) aldehyde from sulfonyl chloride + aniline (sulfonamide formation). So final precursors: p-toluidine (4-methylaniline) and p-formyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride (4-formylbenzenesulfonyl chloride). Also malonic acid is a reagent (not a precursor). The aniline for amide step is aniline (c3ccccc3N). That's separate.

Thus we need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each reaction. We can search for templates matching these transformations.

First, sulfonamide formation: search for templates where functional_groups_formed: ["sulfonamides"], broken: maybe ["aryl halide"]? In earlier search we got template 1313644 which is sulfonamide formation from aryl chloride + amine. That seems appropriate: reactants: Cl-[S](=O)(=O)-c and amine. So we can use that template ID 1313644.

Second, Doebner modification: need template that forms C-C double bond and breaks carboxylic acid? Actually forward reaction: aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. In retrosynthesis, we break double bond to aldehyde and malonic acid. Search for template where functional_groups_broken includes "C-C double bonds" and formed includes "carboxylic acid"? Let's search.
